description: You threw a golf ball at me. But I saw that coming, so I had a tennis racquet handy. Then you threw a running chainsaw at me. But I saw it coming, so I had a plexiglass safety cage handy. I see that rabid ferret behind your back... I’ll be in the car.
instruments: Synths, Percussion, Bass, Strings, Cellos, Violas, Violins
title: Outfoxing the Fox
